cases.expected: Compact Contract; no Luna, Sol or file-level implementation ceremony.
AGY implements/self-reviews but does not execute the frozen test plan or acceptance gates.

cases.setup: AGY implementation is ready for review.
cases.expected: Astra inspects complete code delta only; no test/build/quality-gate execution in code-review phase.

cases.setup: Astra finds a material code defect.
cases.expected: Bounded finding returns to AGY; revised code is reviewed again until PASS/BLOCKED.
Only now Astra freezes Test Plan and measurable acceptance metrics bound to reviewed code digest.
AGY reports FAIL/BLOCKED; it cannot lower threshold, remove required check or redefine PASS.

cases.setup: All frozen required checks and metrics pass on current digest.
cases.expected: Task completes mechanically from frozen criteria; Astra does not perform a second test-review pass.

cases.setup: AGY changes production code while fixing a test failure.
cases.expected: Prior CODE_REVIEW_PASS/test plan become STALE; return to Astra code review then refresh test plan.
No stash/reset/clean; task delta remains distinguishable from baseline.

cases.setup: Task has committed, staged, unstaged and untracked changes.
cases.expected: Astra code review covers all task-introduced content, deletions/renames and relevant binary changes.

cases.setup: AGENTS.md defines API propagation and required quality gates.
cases.expected: Astra code review checks required propagation; Astra test plan includes applicable required gates.

cases.setup: Implementation, rework or test execution is required.

cases.setup: Herdr worker is still executing prior order.

cases.expected: Record uncertainty, inspect/read first, never automatically resend.

cases.setup: Recorded AGY session cannot be restored exactly.
cases.expected: Do not guess; replace only after old writer cannot still write.

cases.setup: Required test cannot run due to auth/dependency.
